title: ocotea lucida
intro: Ocotea lucida, commonly known as Mountain Pepper or Rainforest Pepper, is a plant species that belongs to the Lauraceae family, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The health benefits of Ocotea lucida include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Ocotea lucida are attributed to its antimicrobial, antifungal, and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against infections and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include caryophyllene, eugenol, and limonene, which are known for their anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities.
